Contract ManageUserCRUDService::createUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		u: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = userid)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		let newUser: User in
		u.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		newUser.oclIsNew() and
		User.allInstance()->includes(newUser) and
		newUser.UserID = userid and
		newUser.Name = name and
		newUser.Address = address and
		result = true or
		u.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		result = true
}
